title: Copilot-assisted and AI-free C programming tasks
summary: Graduate students complete low-level C programming tasks under both GitHub Copilot-assisted and independent conditions. The sequence measures routine coding, pointer and memory-management work, debugging, and whether students can solve later tasks without AI support.
